summary: Regression verification of the 6 endpoints that received a MongoDB .limit() clause (deployment blocker fix). Added dedicated regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_limits_regression.py — 17 passed, 1 skipped (wound-photo analyze, intentionally skipped per review). Also re-ran the full existing suite (backend_test.py) with the analyze test deselected: 27/27 passed. All 6 endpoints (/api/readings, /api/sessions, /api/alerts, /api/contacts, /api/wound-photos, /api/doctor/patients) still return correct data, correct filtering (range=24h|7d|30d), correct sort order, and correct role enforcement (403 for patient on /doctor/patients). Bulk-create-then-list confirms the .limit() clauses do NOT truncate when item counts are below the cap. Auth smoke (register/login/auth/me) still passes. No regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py limits verified at expected lines: readings=2000 (L353), sessions=200 (L387), alerts=200 (L409), contacts=500 (L447), wound_photos=100 (L543), doctor/patients=1000 (L701). All limits sit AFTER the .sort() call so ordering is preserved before the cap is applied — correct MongoDB idiom.

The wound_photos limit of 100 is intentionally lower than the raw storage cap; if base64 payloads remain in the DB, this is prudent (large documents). Consider a separate paginated endpoint if patients accumulate >100 photos over time.
No index hints supplied on .sort() fields — with 1000s of readings per user, /api/readings could benefit from a compound index on (user_id, timestamp). Not a blocker.

success_rate.backend: 100% (17/17 new limits-regression tests + 27/27 existing tests, wound analyze deselected per review)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_ users and TEST_ contacts/alerts/readings/sessions created per test-module. All namespaced with test_limit_ prefix for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://wound-healing-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Two regression suites are now maintained: (1) backend_test.py — full CRUD + auth + calendar + doctor + wound-analysis; (2) test_limits_regression.py — focused on the 6 .limit()ed endpoints. Run with: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/ -v`. To skip the expensive Emergent LLM wound-analyze test add: `--deselect backend/tests/backend_test.py::TestWoundAnalysis`.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration is a regression verification, not a bug fix. The deployment agent's fix (adding .limit() clauses to 6 unbounded MongoDB queries) is confirmed non-breaking: all endpoints still return correct data, ordering is preserved, filters (range parameter, role-based auth) still work, and item counts below the cap are not truncated.
